Messages.Author: Lambach
Messages.Body: Can you play action modifiers that are played as the action is announced (like seduction) if you draw them to replace your action card, or must they be played simultaneously with the action card?

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
Nothing is played simultaneously without explicit card text.

You can only play action modifiers, even those played 'as the action is announced', after replacing the action card.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
... and you can play them one by one (even one you've just drawn).

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Correct answers from Adonai and Ankha.
You can play Govern at inferior, replace, and play the Seduction you've just drawn.
